Our Environment & Culture Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment. Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most. Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy. Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices . About the Role As a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer (DevOps), you will serve as a key technical practitioner on our Platform Engineering team, taking personal ownership of our cloud platform, CI/CD pipelines, and internal developer platforms. In this role, you will help build, scale, and fortify global cloud infrastructure designed to handle mission-critical, high-throughput payment applications with zero downtime. You will lead initiatives that strip away friction for engineering teams, architecting golden paths, automating deployment pipelines, and building self-healing infrastructure. Rather than executing against rigid task lists or managing manual deployments, you will bring high agency to your daily work, pioneering automated CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and AI-augmented developer tooling across the entire SDLC. We are looking for hands-on builders who refuse to settle for the status quo, hate manual toil, and take immense pride in elevating developer velocity, platform reliability, and cloud security. Drive our evolution toward standardized, globally scalable platform infrastructure managed entirely through code (IaC). Accelerate CI/CD & Developer Velocity: Own, modernize, and scale our continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. Build self-service platforms and "Golden Paths" that empower feature developers to ship code to production safely, autonomously, and rapidly. Drive Resiliency & GitOps Automation: Replace manual toil with self-healing, automated infrastructure using GitOps methodologies (Flux/ArgoCD), modern automation scripts, and reproducible environment templates. Deep Observability & Operational Rigor: Configure and maintain comprehensive telemetry tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to proactively spot system bottlenecks. Participate in on-call rotations and lead blameless post-mortems to continuously harden system resilience. Security & Network Engineering: Embed security guardrails and compliance practices directly into deployment workflows, ensuring cloud security, API gateways, and network isolation are enforced continuously as code. Platform Enablement & Mentorship: Partner strategically with product and engineering teams to drive platform adoption. Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on modern SRE, DevOps, and cloud-native practices. What You Bring Ownership at Scale: 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure roles, taking personal ownership of complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments. Containerization & GitOps Orchestration: Advanced experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and modern GitOps deployment workflows (ArgoCD, Flux, GitHub Actions). CI/CD Pipeline Mastery: Proven track record building, optimizing, and securing automated CI/CD deployment pipelines that support high-frequency engineering releases. Automation & Scripting: Strong coding/scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash for platform tooling, custom operators, and operational automation. Observability & SRE Practice: Hands-on experience implementing end-to-end telemetry and monitoring stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar modern toolchains. Growth Mindset & High Agency: An innate drive to eliminate manual friction, automate repetitive tasks, and acquire whatever missing context is needed to solve complex platform challenges end-to-end. Nice to Have: Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products BA/BS degree A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment Experience managing distributed data streaming platforms like Kafka (MSK) or high-concurrency database platforms under heavy load. Hands-on experience integrating AI developer tools, agentic workflows, or automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Practical understanding of operating within regulated security frameworks such as PCI-DSS, SOC2, or ISO27001. $80,000 - $85,000 a year Equal Opportunity We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).
